description:
After giving it his all, UK boxer Conor Benn is met with silence, strength, and support from his dad, Nigel Benn.
 Not advice. Not critique. Just: I’ve got you.

This is the kind of support men desperately need. And this moment is such a powerful example of that. This is the role model.

Drop a comment with your thoughts below. 

Original clip: @fxshionconcept
transcript: so this video is connor ben he's an amazing boxer out of the uk and this is right after his fight that went to the cards and he ended up losing and it was amazing fight i mean this this man poured everything into what he had. He poured everything he had into this fight. And this video, this clip, is his father comforting him after the fight. And I think this is the type of paternal connection that so many men long for. This is the type of, you know, masculine, I've got your back. It's like, this guy just went to war. He just gave everything that he had. There's no words. His father's not saying anything to him. He's not trying to be like, next time you'll get him or none of that stuff. He's just holding his son. And I think that that is something that is so necessary and so needed for so many men's lives whether it's a brother whether it's a friend um you know whether it is a he is your father it is your uncle but it's this type of support that i think men really desperately need and this is such a good example of that this is the role model so leave your comments below love to hear your thoughts
